3.name: Journey to Jingdu
3.overview: Lü Shu is summoned to the capital city, Jingdu, to formally report his actions and face an evaluation by the supreme leaders of the organization.

3.name: The Overseas Assignment
3.overview: To keep his presence low-profile domestically, Tian Luo Di Wang assigns Lü Shu to a covert international mission, sending him across Southeast Asia (Thailand) and Japan. Here, he crosses paths with the powerful foreign heiress, Carol Odin Johnson (Ka Luo'er).

3.name: A Chaos In Deep Cover
3.overview: Lü Shu’s arrives in Thailand. Having agreed to the Tianluo Diwang organization's request to go off-the-grid, he completely sheds his official identity. He begins establishing his persona as a rogue, independent meta-human mercenary.

3.name: The Black Market Meet
3.overview: Lü Shu scams black market buyers to harvest mass negative emotion points and is ambushed by international mercenaries.

3.name: The Nordic Goddess Arrives
3.overview: Lü Shu’s black-market trolling completely breaks the local syndicates. Their desperate attempt to corner him crashes directly into the arrival of Carol Odin Johnson, triggering an all-out collision between China's ultimate troll and the international magical elite.

3.name: Escalation in Thailand
3.overview: Lü Shu’s relentless black-market trolling finally pushes the local syndicates over the edge, causing a massive local crackdown that crashes directly into the arrival of Carol and the international magical elite.

3.name: The Practical Alliance
3.overview: Lü Shu and Carol officially join forces to navigate the chaotic fallout of the black-market clashes. Their new alliance forces local syndicates to retreat while drawing the direct, hostile attention of major international meta-human organizations.

overview:
Lü Shu is a frail teenager with an iron will. After losing his parents, he enrolls in a prestigious high school while working for a living and looking after his adoptive sister, Lü Xiaoyu. However, Lü Shu's quiet life abruptly changes when a car accident awakens his latent cultivation superpowers. Now cured of his physical weakness, he decides to hide his newfound abilities, as the art of cultivation is still shrouded in mystery—and the fate of cultivators uncertain.

Meanwhile, Tian Luo Di Wang, the international foundation responsible for monitoring the cultivators, sets its plans in motion. Under the impetus of their member Xi Fei, a special cultivation training group is established in Lü Shu's high school. Although Lü Shu is forced to join the program, he is determined to hide the nature of his fearsome power, for his cultivation draws from an unlimited resource: the negative emotions of others brought about by his actions.

seasons.name: Awakening & The Daoyuan Class
seasons.overview: Introduces Lü Shu's awakening, his daily life with Lü Xiaoyu, his entry into the special cultivation high school class, and his early hidden exploits as spirit energy returns to the world.

seasons.name: The Qingzhou Ruins
seasons.overview: Follows Lü Shu deeper into mysterious supernatural ruins (such as the Qingzhou Ruins), facing spirit zombies, rival cultivators, and expanding his combat skills and items.

seasons.name: Overseas Expeditions (International Missions)
seasons.overview: Picking up after the Qingzhou Ruins as Lü Shu travels to Jingdu to report on his duties, before heading overseas on cultivation missions to Thailand and Japan alongside Tian Luo Di Wang.
